title: Marie Stopes International (MSI) - proposed acquisition of GS Brodie Pty Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Marie Stopes International acquires GS Brodie Pty Ltd
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the following markets in its review of MSI's acquisition of GS Brodie Pty Limited: - Camperdown markets for reproductive and sexual health care services; and - Kingswood markets for reproductive and sexual health care services.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considers that MSI faces sufficient competitive constraints post-acquisition and that the acquisition is unlikely to cause a substantial lessening of competition in any of the relevant markets. This conclusion was informed by the following factors: - MSI's acquisition of GS Brodie will result in a bare transfer of market share in the Kingswood markets for   reproductive and sexual health care services; - Barriers to entry and expansion are relatively low into the relevant markets; - There are a number of alternative suppliers to MSI and GS Brodie providing reproductive and sexual health   care services in the Camperdown markets.
